name: murphy-infra
description: Docker Compose serving stack for the Murphy RAG system (backend + frontend + datastores + embedding service).

scripts.stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.base.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.dev down
scripts.restart: docker compose -f docker-compose.base.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.dev restart
